lists.name: Flame

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.effect: Hurl a small bolt of fire at one target. HOL keeps the dependable attack and resolves damage through Weak, Standard and Strong results.

spells.name: Boil Liquid
spells.effect: Bring an existing container of liquid to a boil. Heating takes time; it does not instantly boil a creature's blood.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.effect: Release a short fan of fire from your hands. Its identity is close-range area damage, rather than a longer Fire Bolt.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.effect: Heat an existing metal object. Worn armor and held weapons make this a pressure spell with a sustained cost.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.effect: Launch several separate rays of fire. The page specifies their combined damage budget and permitted targets.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.effect: Create a dangerous line or ring of flame. Crossing it and remaining beside it have explicit, bounded consequences.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.effect: Detonate a visible point in a burst of fire. Allies in the area are at risk; the roll controls damage, not whether the blast exists.

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.effect: Surround yourself with a thermal ward that protects against one opposing element and burns creatures striking you nearby.

advanced.name: Fire Storm
advanced.effect: Shape several connected areas of violent fire into one major battlefield effect.

advanced.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
advanced.effect: Hold a growing fireball at a visible point before releasing it. Delay, interruption and safe handling need explicit limits.

advanced.name: Incendiary Cloud
advanced.effect: Create a moving cloud of smoke and searing heat that threatens a large area while maintained.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Fire Law (p. 82); HARP: Elemental Bolt / Ball (p. 133).

lists.name: Water

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.effect: Strike one target with cold and briefly hinder its movement. Damage and hindrance follow a fixed HOL result profile.

spells.name: Create or Destroy Water
spells.effect: Produce a bounded amount of ordinary water or remove it from an eligible container or area; never remove bodily fluids.

spells.name: Purify Food and Drink
spells.effect: Remove ordinary spoilage and poison from existing provisions. It does not create additional food or cure a poisoned creature.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.effect: Give a willing group the ability to breathe underwater for a defined duration.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.effect: Allow willing creatures to move over a liquid surface without turning that surface into solid material.

spells.name: Control Water
spells.effect: Manipulate an existing body of water through an authored set of currents, lowered surfaces and flooding effects.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.effect: Pelt an area with ice and leave hazardous footing. The spell combines impact, cold and temporary terrain.

spells.name: Wall of Ice
spells.effect: Build a finite barrier of ice that can be broken or melted and leaves a dangerous cold breach.

advanced.name: Cone of Cold
advanced.effect: Project a broad cone of extreme cold with substantial damage and a clearly defined area.

advanced.name: Freezing Sphere
advanced.effect: Create a concentrated freezing burst that can also freeze a bounded surface of water.

advanced.name: Tsunami
advanced.effect: Raise a massive moving wave through a major working. Its travel, damage and ability to carry creatures are explicitly bounded.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Water Law and Ice Law (pp. 83–84).

lists.name: Earth

spells.name: Enchanted Rope
spells.effect: Guide an existing rope into a knot or around a support. This minor form cannot attack or bind an unwilling creature.

spells.name: Loosen Earth
spells.effect: Turn compact ground into workable loose soil, making excavation possible without removing the material.

spells.name: Earthwall
spells.effect: Raise a barrier of packed earth from suitable ground. It can be dug through or destroyed.

spells.name: Cracks Call
spells.effect: Extend existing flaws in a bounded object or structure. The spell exploits a weakness rather than conjuring an earthquake.

spells.name: Meld into Stone
spells.effect: Hide yourself within a sufficiently large piece of stone, subject to defined perception and exit restrictions.

spells.name: Stone Shape
spells.effect: Reshape a bounded quantity of stone into a useful simple form, passage or closure.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.effect: Give a willing creature stone-like resistance to physical harm for a limited duration and maintenance cost.

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.effect: Raise connected stone panels. Lasting construction requires sustained work and an appropriate foundation.

advanced.name: Move Earth
advanced.effect: Reshape a substantial area of soil over time, creating trenches, slopes and embankments.

advanced.name: Flesh to Stone
advanced.effect: Make progress toward petrifying one living target. The target has defined opportunities to interrupt or reverse the transformation.

advanced.name: Earthquake
advanced.effect: Cause a major local tremor that threatens structures and footing. Its collateral effects are part of its identity.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Earth Law (p. 82).

lists.name: Air

spells.name: Elementalism — Air
spells.effect: Use the air application of Elementalism: stir dust, ripple cloth and move a small amount of air. Other elemental applications are not included.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.effect: Use a reaction to slow nearby falling creatures and carry them to a safe landing within the spell's limits.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.effect: Fill a bounded area with obscuring mist. The fog conceals both allies and enemies and can be dispersed by wind.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.effect: Drive a strong line of wind through an area, pushing against movement and dispersing light gases.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.effect: Raise one creature or object vertically. Horizontal movement requires some other means of propulsion.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.effect: Send a line of lightning through a sequence of targets and conductive surroundings.

spells.name: Fly
spells.effect: Grant a willing creature controlled flight for a limited duration, including an explicit procedure for the spell ending.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.effect: Create a wall of churning air that obstructs light missiles, flying debris and small airborne creatures.

advanced.name: Chain Lightning
advanced.effect: Strike one target with lightning and arc to several nearby secondary targets within a shared damage budget.

advanced.name: Control Weather
advanced.effect: Change regional weather gradually through a sustained major working; it is not an instant indoor attack.

advanced.name: Wind Walk
advanced.effect: Transform a willing traveling group into cloud-like forms with exceptional movement but restricted interaction.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Wind Law (p. 84); HARP: Air Wall, Fly (pp. 131, 134).

lists.name: Restoration
lists.theme: Repair the body without bypassing recovery limits.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.effect: Stabilize a dying creature without restoring HP. HOL death strikes and permanent scars remain governed by the recovery rules.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.effect: Restore HP through touch. Healing is limited by the caster's SP and the final recipient recovery rules.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.effect: Restore a small amount of HP to a visible ally through a spoken word, using a clearly specified action-economy cost.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.effect: Remove one eligible minor bodily affliction. The page lists the conditions it can address.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.effect: Restore several willing creatures through a period of uninterrupted care; it cannot be compressed into a combat action.

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
spells.effect: Give a small amount of immediate healing to several visible allies using a shared healing budget.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.effect: Remove a specified major affliction or lasting magical impairment, with substantial cost and any required material.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.effect: Restore a larger pool of HP across a bounded group of nearby creatures.

advanced.name: Heal
advanced.effect: Deliver substantial restoration to one creature and remove the explicitly listed bodily afflictions.

advanced.name: Regenerate
advanced.effect: Restore damaged body parts through a sustained recovery effect. It does not return a departed spirit.

advanced.name: Mass Heal
advanced.effect: Distribute a major but finite amount of restoration among a group; normal recovery restrictions still apply.

lists.inspiration: HARP: Minor Healing, Major Healing, Restoration (pp. 121, 125, 127).

lists.name: Transformation

spells.name: Hues
spells.effect: Blend your coloration into nearby surroundings. This minor form changes color, not shape, size or identity.

spells.name: Jump
spells.effect: Give one willing creature a greatly improved leap, with an explicit movement cost and landing requirement.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.effect: Improve a willing creature's ordinary movement speed for a limited duration.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.effect: Adopt one authored physical adaptation or appearance change; the page defines which forms are learned.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce — Living
spells.effect: Change a willing or contested creature's size. The corresponding strength, equipment and space effects are stated together.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.effect: Adapt a creature's sight to darkness without revealing invisible objects or defeating every magical obscuration.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.effect: Transform a creature into an eligible beast form with a fixed profile and clear rules for damage and reversion.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.effect: Allow a willing creature to move through specified restraints and difficult environments.

advanced.name: Animal Shapes
advanced.effect: Transform a willing group into eligible animal forms under one sustained working.

advanced.name: Shapechange
advanced.effect: Assume a powerful studied form with clearly bounded access to its abilities.

advanced.name: True Polymorph — Living
advanced.effect: Perform a major transformation involving a living subject. Lasting change requires sustained commitment and explicit reversal rules.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Living Change; HARP: Changing Ways (pp. 131–132).

lists.name: Growth

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.effect: Perform a minor natural sign: forecast nearby weather, open a blossom or create a harmless sensory effect.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.effect: Cause roots and vines to hinder creatures in a bounded area. Escape uses a defined progress procedure.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.effect: Enchant a small supply of berries that nourish and provide limited healing. Their creation consumes SP and obeys recovery limits.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.effect: Communicate with nearby plants about their limited experience and ask for modest cooperation.

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.effect: Transform a patch of ground into a thorny hazard whose damage is tied to movement through it.

spells.name: Plant Growth
spells.effect: Thicken existing vegetation or improve cultivated land over time. The spell does not create mature food from nothing.

spells.name: Tree Skin
spells.effect: Give a willing subject bark-like protection while preserving its living form and movement.

spells.name: Tree Stride
spells.effect: Move between suitable living trees within a bounded connected route.

advanced.name: Awaken
advanced.effect: Grant awareness to an eligible plant through a costly prepared working; awakening does not create permanent obedience.

advanced.name: Wall of Thorns
advanced.effect: Create a substantial thorn barrier that obstructs movement and harms creatures forcing their way through.

advanced.name: Transport via Plants
advanced.effect: Open a temporary route between suitable known living plants for travelers to pass through.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Plant Mastery; HARP: Tree Skin, Tree Door (p. 127).

lists.name: Decay

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.effect: Project a short-range cloud of poison at one target. Its attack profile is fixed; immunity and protection still matter.

spells.name: Ray of Sickness
spells.effect: Damage a target with a sickening ray and apply a defined temporary poison effect.

spells.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
spells.effect: Weaken one target's physical attacks through a sustained effect with an explicit escape condition.

spells.name: Protection from Poison
spells.effect: Neutralize an eligible poison and protect a willing creature against further poisoning for a limited duration.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.effect: Drain life through repeated touch attacks while maintaining the spell. Healing cannot exceed the actual life taken or bypass recovery limits.

spells.name: Bestow Curse
spells.effect: Place one authored curse on a target. Its effect, duration and removal conditions are known when the page is learned.

spells.name: Blight
spells.effect: Wither a living target with destructive magic, especially effective against plants.

spells.name: Contagion
spells.effect: Afflict a target with a specified supernatural disease whose onset, effects and removal are explicit.

advanced.name: Harm
advanced.effect: Inflict severe bodily deterioration on one creature without using an automatic-death rule.

advanced.name: Finger of Death
advanced.effect: Deliver a potent necrotic attack. Any resulting undead servant uses a strict control and action budget.

advanced.name: Circle of Death
advanced.effect: Release a large-area pulse of destructive life-draining magic with substantial cost and collateral danger.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Flesh Destruction and Disease; HARP: Harm, Drain Life (p. 124).

lists.name: Thought
lists.theme: Communication and bounded access to thought.

spells.name: Message
spells.effect: Send a short whispered message to one nearby subject and hear its reply. It does not read unspoken thoughts.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.effect: Understand the literal meaning of spoken or written language without automatically understanding ciphers or cultural context.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.effect: Read surface thoughts and attempt a deeper probe within a clearly defined scope; resistance matters.

spells.name: Tongues
spells.effect: Let a creature understand speech and make its own speech understood across language barriers.

spells.name: Sending
spells.effect: Deliver a short message to a familiar creature over a great distance and receive a brief reply.

spells.name: Telepathic Bond
spells.effect: Connect willing participants in a shared mental conversation without giving access to their private memories.

spells.name: Modify Memory
spells.effect: Alter a bounded remembered event under explicit resistance, duration and restoration rules.

spells.name: Inner Thoughts
spells.effect: Probe the reasoning behind a subject's immediate surface thoughts; it does not reveal an entire life history.

advanced.name: Mind Scan
advanced.effect: Search conscious memories for a bounded subject through sustained investigation.

advanced.name: Mind Probe
advanced.effect: Reach deeper stored memories through a major resisted working with explicit limits and consequences.

advanced.name: Thought Steal
advanced.effect: Remove a specific accessible memory through a resisted working. The page defines restoration and what remains discoverable.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Mind Speech, Mind Visions (pp. 117, 120).

lists.name: Emotion
lists.theme: Influence feelings without dictating every decision.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.effect: Deliver a cutting magical insult that causes psychic harm and briefly undermines the target's next attack.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.effect: Bolster a willing creature against fear and give a small, explicitly limited protective benefit.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.effect: Make one person regard you more favorably temporarily. It does not grant obedience, erase evidence or override every relationship.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.effect: Suppress a defined emotional disturbance or temporarily reduce hostility within a bounded group.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.effect: Plant one plausible course of action, subject to clear limits, resistance and ending conditions.

spells.name: Fear
spells.effect: Project a terrifying presence that drives a bounded fear response rather than unlimited control.

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.effect: Extend temporary charm to a broader range of creatures, retaining the limits on obedience.

spells.name: Confusion
spells.effect: Disrupt a group’s ability to act coherently using a short, predictable HOL behavior procedure.

advanced.name: Mass Suggestion
advanced.effect: Give one bounded suggestion to several creatures; the instruction and its limits are shared.

advanced.name: Dominate Person
advanced.effect: Direct one person's actions under a costly maintained effect, with explicit breaks in control and no extra caster turn.

advanced.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
advanced.effect: Make a prepared subject strongly repel or attract a defined category of creature under explicit resistance rules.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Mind Control; HARP: Calm, Charm, Fear (pp. 129, 133).

lists.name: Perception
lists.theme: Illusions experienced by minds, not physical matter.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.effect: Create one small sound or static visual illusion. It has no physical substance and does not deal damage.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.effect: Create and move a visual illusion while concentrating; it contains no sound or tactile substance.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.effect: Change your apparent clothing and appearance without changing your physical body.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.effect: Create shifting duplicates around yourself that interfere with attacks through a bounded defensive profile.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.effect: Conceal a subject from ordinary sight until the effect ends or its stated breaking action occurs.

spells.name: Major Image
spells.effect: Create a larger moving illusion incorporating several senses while retaining no physical substance.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.effect: Maintain invisibility through actions that would end the lesser spell, at higher cost and limited duration.

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
spells.effect: Disguise a landscape's appearance without physically changing its obstacles or hazards.

advanced.name: Mislead
advanced.effect: Become concealed while projecting a mobile illusory double.

advanced.name: Seeming
advanced.effect: Apply coordinated illusory disguises to a willing group.

advanced.name: Programmed Illusion
advanced.effect: Prepare a detailed illusion with a fixed trigger and sequence of behavior.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Lesser Illusions and Illusion Mastery; HARP: Phantasms (p. 136).

lists.name: Dreams
lists.theme: Sleep, dreams and their remembered impressions.

spells.name: Dreams
spells.effect: Receive symbolic impressions about one chosen topic during natural sleep. This minor form is limited to one dream per full rest.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.effect: Make progress toward putting nearby susceptible creatures to sleep. Disturbance and harm provide explicit awakening conditions.

spells.name: Dream Message
spells.effect: Use only Dream's message-bearing application to meet a willing known sleeper. Hostile nightmares are not included on this page.

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
spells.effect: Create a convincing mental illusion for one target, with bounded consequences and a clear way to investigate it.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.effect: Distract a bounded group with a captivating pattern; harm and assistance can break the effect.

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer
spells.effect: Assault one mind with a personal nightmare that causes fear and psychic harm while maintained.

spells.name: Dream
spells.effect: Enter a known sleeper's dream to communicate or attempt a specified disturbing nightmare.

spells.name: Sign of Sleep
spells.effect: Prepare a fixed sleep-triggering inscription on an eligible stationary surface; its trigger and removal are explicit.

advanced.name: Lord Dream
advanced.effect: Seek several distinct symbolic dreams during a full rest through a major prepared working.

advanced.name: Weird
advanced.effect: Manifest shared nightmare imagery that threatens a group with fear and psychic harm.

advanced.name: Astral Projection
advanced.effect: Separate willing travelers' astral forms from their bodies for a major journey, preserving explicit return and vulnerability rules.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Future Visions (p. 121); HARP: Dreams (p. 124).

lists.name: Detection

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.effect: Sense nearby active magic while concentrating. Further details require inspection; the spell is not automatic item identification.

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.effect: Locate eligible poisons or diseases within a bounded area and identify their general nature.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.effect: Sense specified supernatural creature types and consecrated or desecrated places; it does not reveal everyone's morality.

spells.name: Find Traps
spells.effect: Notice the presence of qualifying traps in view without automatically finding every mechanism or disarming them.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.effect: Perceive invisible creatures and objects within ordinary line of sight.

spells.name: Identify
spells.effect: Study an accessible object or effect to learn defined magical properties, requirements and limitations.

spells.name: True Seeing
spells.effect: Perceive through specified forms of visual deception within a bounded range and duration.

spells.name: Analysis
spells.effect: Study one target to learn one broad, bounded characteristic; HOL does not reveal a complete character sheet.

advanced.name: Detect Magic — Scaling Analysis
advanced.effect: Inspect a known effect to determine how it has been strengthened or altered, using HARP's deeper detection application.

advanced.name: Find the Path
advanced.effect: Receive guidance along a viable route to a specifically known destination, with the required connection and preparation.

advanced.name: Sight True
advanced.effect: See through bounded intervening nonliving material while concentrating; the HOL page fixes its depth and range.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Detecting Ways and True Perception (p. 119); HARP: Detect Magic / Trap (p. 119).

lists.name: Farseeing
lists.theme: Observe beyond ordinary reach through defined connections.

spells.name: Nightsight
spells.effect: Improve your sight in ordinary darkness for a short time; this minor form does not penetrate magical darkness.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.effect: Place a remote viewing or listening sensor at a qualifying location and concentrate on its observations.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.effect: Sense the direction of a known object within a bounded range, subject to blocking materials and familiarity limits.

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.effect: Seek a familiar creature or a defined creature type within a bounded range.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.effect: Move an invisible visual sensor through accessible openings while concentrating.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.effect: Observe a known or linked subject from a distance under explicit connection and resistance rules.

spells.name: Long Ear
spells.effect: Move your listening point along a physically accessible route; it cannot simply pass through sealed walls.

spells.name: Watch II
spells.effect: Observe two prepared viewpoints under a shared concentration limit.

advanced.name: Watch True
advanced.effect: Maintain a prepared viewpoint with less active attention, still reserving the required sustained resource.

advanced.name: Long Sense
advanced.effect: Extend several senses to a remote point through a stronger version of the sensory working.

advanced.name: Long Sense True
advanced.effect: Establish an exceptional long-distance sensory connection to a defined destination; HOL fixes its scope rather than granting omniscience.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: True Sight, True Perception (p. 119).

lists.name: Echoes
lists.theme: Read traces left by past events.

spells.name: Origins
spells.effect: Learn a broad impression of where a touched object originated. The minor page provides no detailed ownership history.

spells.name: Past Visions
spells.effect: View a recent event associated with a touched object or place, observing only what could have been perceived there.

spells.name: Power Lore
spells.effect: Discover clues to the origin of an item's magical power.

spells.name: Item Vision
spells.effect: Witness a significant event from a touched item's history.

spells.name: Vision Guide
spells.effect: Locate a significant moment to investigate before undertaking a historical vision.

spells.name: Delving
spells.effect: Learn about an item's construction and intended purpose without automatically identifying every magical power.

spells.name: Vision Location
spells.effect: Use a concrete description of an event to guide a subsequent vision toward the closest matching historical scene.

spells.name: Past Store
spells.effect: Preserve a person or place seen in a historical vision as an anchor for later investigation.

advanced.name: Legend Lore
advanced.effect: Recover significant lore about a genuinely important person, place or object through a prepared working.

advanced.name: Past Truth
advanced.effect: Investigate whether statements heard within a historical vision were knowingly false.

advanced.name: Vision Behind — Ages
advanced.effect: Reach much older events associated with a prepared historical anchor, with explicit age and viewing limits.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Past Visions (p. 121); HARP: Past Visions (pp. 135–136).

lists.name: Portents

spells.name: True Strike
spells.effect: Use magical foresight to guide one weapon attack. This follows the revised 5e attack-cantrip concept; HOL retains the weapon's learned profile and uses its own result bands.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.effect: Give a willing creature a small, bounded insight on an imminent noncombat task. Repeated castings do not stack.

spells.name: Augury
spells.effect: Read an omen concerning a specific near-term course of action; the answer reflects the information and circumstances of the casting.

spells.name: Intuitions
spells.effect: Receive a short vision of the likely immediate consequences of a declared action.

spells.name: Anticipations I
spells.effect: Anticipate the broad category of one creature's next action, not a complete script of its intentions.

spells.name: Spell Anticipations
spells.effect: Recognize an anticipated spell and its intended target when a subject is about to cast.

spells.name: Divination
spells.effect: Ask a bounded question about a future undertaking and receive an informative, potentially symbolic response.

spells.name: Commune
spells.effect: Ask a small set of specific questions of a supernatural source whose knowledge has limits.

advanced.name: Foresight
advanced.effect: Give a willing subject sustained supernatural warning and a strong, explicitly bounded advantage in dangerous situations.

advanced.name: Anticipations True
advanced.effect: Anticipate the immediate broad actions of several nearby creatures under a shared observation limit.

advanced.name: Spell Anticipation True
advanced.effect: Extend advanced spell anticipation to a bounded group, revealing the imminent spells and targets you can actually perceive.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Future Visions (p. 121); HARP: Intuitions (p. 125).

lists.name: Spirits
lists.theme: Contact incorporeal beings and understand hauntings.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.effect: Channel the chill of death through a touch attack and briefly prevent the target from regaining HP. Uses the revised 5e close-range identity.

spells.name: Gentle Repose
spells.effect: Preserve a corpse from decay and unwanted animation for a defined duration; it does not return the dead to life.

spells.name: Speak with Dead
spells.effect: Ask a corpse a limited number of questions drawn from what it knew in life; it cannot acquire new knowledge.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.effect: Surround yourself with manifested guardians that hinder and harm eligible nearby enemies while maintained.

spells.name: Lifekeeping
spells.effect: Hold a departing life briefly at the boundary of death so others can address its fatal injuries; final HOL timing must match death strikes.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.effect: Animate eligible remains under explicit control, duration and action limits; the spell does not restore the former person.

spells.name: Control Undead
spells.effect: Attempt to direct an eligible undead being through a resisted effect with a limited control budget.

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
spells.effect: Seek answers from a distant supernatural intelligence through a risky prepared contact.

advanced.name: Etherealness
advanced.effect: Enter an adjacent incorporeal state with explicit limits on movement, interaction and return.

advanced.name: Create Undead
advanced.effect: Create a more capable undead servant through a costly working and strict control limits.

advanced.name: Lifegiving
advanced.effect: Reunite a willing departed spirit with a viable body inside a defined time window. Fatal bodily damage must first be repaired.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Communal Ways and Life Mastery; HARP: Lifekeeping / Lifegiving (p. 125).

lists.name: Calling

spells.name: Familiar
spells.effect: Begin a bond with an existing small willing animal through repeated care and attunement. The free page does not create replacement animals or an army.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.effect: Call a minor familiar with defined senses, assistance and replacement costs; it does not gain unrestricted combat actions.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.effect: Call an invisible helper for simple noncombat tasks with fixed strength, reach and duration.

spells.name: Summon Animal
spells.effect: Call an eligible animal for a bounded purpose; disposition and control follow the authored spell profile.

spells.name: Phantom Steed
spells.effect: Create a temporary supernatural mount with clear fragility and travel limits.

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.effect: Manifest an animal-themed supernatural effect with a fixed shared action and damage budget.

spells.name: Conjure Elemental
spells.effect: Manifest elemental power at a chosen location under a maintained, bounded effect.

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.effect: Call a draconic spirit with a fixed profile, finite durability and a shared command economy.

advanced.name: Conjure Celestial
advanced.effect: Manifest a potent celestial presence with a defined protective and offensive area.

advanced.name: Planar Ally
advanced.effect: Request service from a powerful otherworldly being. Terms and payment matter; summoning does not compel agreement.

advanced.name: Gate — Calling
advanced.effect: Open Gate's calling application to invite or draw a specified being. The page does not grant general free planar travel.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Gate Mastery (p. 80); HARP: Summon Animal (p. 127).

lists.name: Binding

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.effect: Manifest a minor supernatural sign or commanding voice. It conveys presence, not obedience or damage.

spells.name: Command
spells.effect: Give one brief command with clear comprehension, resistance and harmful-instruction limits.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.effect: Make progress toward immobilizing an eligible person; continuing resistance can end the hold.

spells.name: Magic Circle
spells.effect: Prepare a boundary that contains or excludes specified supernatural beings under explicit crossing rules.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.effect: Remove an eligible creature temporarily or return an outsider under defined duration and resistance conditions.

spells.name: Planar Binding
spells.effect: Bind an eligible summoned being to service through a prepared working with explicit duration and terms.

spells.name: Geas
spells.effect: Impose a specified supernatural obligation and a bounded consequence for deliberate violation; it is not unrestricted puppetry.

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.effect: Extend a powerful holding effect to a broader range of creatures with continuing escape opportunities.

advanced.name: Dominate Monster
advanced.effect: Direct one eligible creature through a costly sustained effect and a shared action budget.

advanced.name: Forcecage
advanced.effect: Confine creatures within a powerful fixed enclosure with explicit magical escape conditions.

advanced.name: Imprisonment
advanced.effect: Perform a major binding using a chosen form, significant preparation and a specified release condition.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Spirit Mastery and Gate Mastery; 5e: binding and control spells.

lists.name: Passage

spells.name: Landing
spells.effect: Reduce the danger of a short fall. The free minor form has a fixed safe-drop limit and is not flight.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.effect: Move yourself a short distance to a visible unoccupied destination using a clearly specified action-economy cost.

spells.name: Blink
spells.effect: Slip intermittently into an adjacent plane, with predictable HOL timing and clear restrictions on interaction.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.effect: Transport yourself and an eligible passenger to a specified destination within range, with explicit blocked-destination consequences.

spells.name: Long Door
spells.effect: Teleport along a defined short route, then gain the learned ability to cross intervening barriers; scope is fixed by this page.

spells.name: Teleportation Circle
spells.effect: Create a temporary connection to a known prepared destination circle.

spells.name: Passwall
spells.effect: Open a temporary passage through an eligible nonliving barrier without destroying an entire structure.

spells.name: Plane Shift
spells.effect: Travel with an eligible group to a specified plane using an appropriate attuned focus.

advanced.name: Teleport
advanced.effect: Transport a group over a great distance; familiarity and destination preparation determine the safe-use procedure.

advanced.name: Gate — Passage
advanced.effect: Create a major traversable connection between planes. This page grants the passage application rather than compulsory creature calling.

advanced.name: Etherealness — Company
advanced.effect: Carry a willing group into an adjacent incorporeal state under shared duration and return limits.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Lofty Bridge (p. 79); HARP: Landing, Long Door (pp. 120, 134–135).

lists.name: Telekinesis

spells.name: Arcane Bolt
spells.effect: Strike one target with concentrated magical energy. HOL reduces this to a 0-SP foundational attack; HARP's paid damage scaling is not automatic.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.effect: Create a small spectral hand for simple remote manipulation. It cannot attack or independently use complex devices.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.effect: Send a small fixed volley of force darts to visible targets. HOL's always-hit system preserves its reliable, divisible damage identity.

spells.name: Staying
spells.effect: Hold a bounded object in position with directed pressure; it does not also move the object or grant fine manipulation.

spells.name: Levitate — Objects
spells.effect: Raise an unattended load vertically under a fixed weight and maintenance limit.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.effect: Break or damage brittle objects and creatures with a burst of resonant force in a bounded area.

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.effect: Move, manipulate or contest control of a substantial object or creature while concentrating.

spells.name: Resilient Sphere
spells.effect: Enclose one eligible subject in a protective force sphere with explicit movement and escape rules.

advanced.name: Wall of Force
advanced.effect: Create a strong temporary barrier of force with a fixed shape, duration and countermeasures.

advanced.name: Disintegrate
advanced.effect: Destroy eligible nonliving material or deliver a potent attack to one creature; living targets still use HOL's damage procedure.

advanced.name: Reverse Gravity
advanced.effect: Reverse gravity in a bounded area, with explicit anchoring, collision and safe-ending procedures.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Essence Hand (p. 72); HARP: Arcane Bolt (p. 118).

lists.name: Shaping
lists.theme: Reshape and repair existing nonliving material.

spells.name: Mending
spells.effect: Repair one small break or tear in an object when the necessary material is present; it does not restore magical properties.

spells.name: Grease
spells.effect: Cover a bounded surface or eligible object in slippery magical grease.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce — Objects
spells.effect: Change an unattended object's size under a fixed mass, duration and interaction limit.

spells.name: Unlocking Ways
spells.effect: Make progress on an eligible mundane lock. Higher complexity is a purchased capability; the spell does not automatically disarm traps.

spells.name: Heat Metal — Forge
spells.effect: Use controlled heating on unattended metal during skilled work; this workshop page grants no combat targeting.

spells.name: Stone Shape — Craft
spells.effect: Shape a bounded stone object using your own design and craft knowledge.

spells.name: Fabricate
spells.effect: Turn suitable raw materials into a finished object. Complex quality still requires the appropriate expertise.

spells.name: Earthen Transmutations
spells.effect: Convert between learned forms of stone, packed earth, loose earth and mud without creating precious material.

advanced.name: Passwall — Workshop
advanced.effect: Create a temporary opening through an eligible material during prepared construction or exploration.

advanced.name: Meld Wall
advanced.effect: Fuse touching stone structures along a bounded seam into a continuous construction.

advanced.name: True Polymorph — Objects
advanced.effect: Perform a major transformation of an eligible object; lasting change requires sustained work and explicit reversal rules.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Earth Law and Organic/Inorganic Skills; HARP: Unlocking Ways, Earthen Transmutations.

lists.name: Animation
lists.theme: Give objects movement and bounded instructions.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.effect: Create a tiny harmless prop or sensory trick. This minor page grants no autonomous worker or combatant.

spells.name: Unseen Servant — Workshop
spells.effect: Direct an invisible helper through simple workshop chores using a fixed noncombat task budget.

spells.name: Enchanted Rope — Rigging
spells.effect: Direct a longer existing rope through an authored sequence of knots and supports; it cannot independently seize a creature.

spells.name: Dancing Weapon
spells.effect: Animate one weapon to fight under your direction. Commands consume the specified action and do not create an extra full turn.

spells.name: Animate Objects
spells.effect: Animate a bounded group of eligible objects under a shared command, durability and damage budget.

spells.name: Low Intelligence
spells.effect: Imbue a prepared object with very limited understanding through costly item creation; it cannot improvise like a person.

spells.name: Medium Intelligence
spells.effect: Develop a prepared object's ability to interpret a broader set of explicit instructions through item creation.

spells.name: High Intelligence
spells.effect: Create a sophisticated intelligent item through a substantial working; intelligence is not an unlimited action engine.

advanced.name: Very High Intelligence
advanced.effect: Create an exceptional intelligent item with a defined personality and capabilities through a major crafting project.

advanced.name: Simulacrum
advanced.effect: Create a costly, limited duplicate with explicit resource and reproduction limits; it cannot manufacture an endless chain of copies.

advanced.name: Animate Objects — Greater
advanced.effect: Animate a larger or more capable collection while retaining one bounded shared command and damage budget.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Enchanting Ways (p. 88); HARP: Dancing Weapon (p. 141).

lists.name: Imbuement

spells.name: Light
spells.effect: Make an object shine with ordinary light. The minor page has a strict simultaneous-object limit.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.effect: Grant one weapon a temporary magical improvement using a fixed HOL profile.

spells.name: Elemental Weapon
spells.effect: Imbue a weapon with a specified elemental attack property selected when the page is learned.

spells.name: Rune Mastery
spells.effect: Inscribe an eligible known spell for later casting, paying its storage and spell costs without creating free SP.

spells.name: Magic Mouth
spells.effect: Place a recorded message on an object with a clearly defined sensory trigger.

spells.name: Continual Flame
spells.effect: Create a lasting magical light through a prepared expenditure; the flame produces light rather than usable combustion heat.

spells.name: Holy Symbol
spells.effect: Consecrate a personal focus through sustained work. Any SP improvement is bounded and cannot be multiplied by making extra symbols.

spells.name: Weapon I
spells.effect: Begin lasting weapon enchantment through skilled work, time and materials; the page does not provide instant free permanent bonuses.

advanced.name: Contingency
advanced.effect: Prepare one eligible known spell to occur under a fixed trigger, reserving its required resources.

advanced.name: Armor IV
advanced.effect: Create a substantial lasting protective enchantment through a major crafting project with finite improvement limits.

advanced.name: General IV
advanced.effect: Create a powerful nonweapon magical item from a defined recipe through a major crafting project.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Enchanting Ways and Rune Mastery (pp. 88, 73); HARP: Rune Mastery (p. 136).

lists.name: Protection
lists.theme: Protect an individual creature or object.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.effect: Call a small radiant flame onto one visible target. HOL makes it a dependable 0-SP attack with a defined cover interaction.

spells.name: Shield
spells.effect: Use a reaction to raise a brief force defense against incoming harm, with a bounded protection value.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.effect: Surround a willing unarmored creature with a sustained magical defense that does not stack freely with armor.

spells.name: Bladeturn
spells.effect: Use a reaction to turn aside one perceived melee attack within the learned range.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.effect: Protect a willing subject against a defined set of supernatural creature types and intrusive effects.

spells.name: Protection from Energy
spells.effect: Protect one willing subject against a learned energy type for a limited duration.

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.effect: Protect a willing creature against one defined fatal event; it does not erase previous death strikes or scars.

spells.name: Warding Bond
spells.effect: Link willing participants so protection and shared harm follow one explicit combined damage budget.

advanced.name: Globe of Invulnerability
advanced.effect: Maintain a protective area that excludes a defined range of lesser hostile magic.

advanced.name: Mind Blank
advanced.effect: Shield one subject from specified mental intrusion and divination for a bounded duration.

advanced.name: Prismatic Wall
advanced.effect: Raise a layered magical barrier whose distinct defenses, hazards and methods of removal are explicitly authored.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Spell Wall and Shield Mastery; HARP: Bladeturn (p. 131).

lists.name: Unraveling

spells.name: Detect Magic — Threads
spells.effect: Sense an accessible active working before attempting to unravel it. The free form does not identify every property.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.effect: Use a reaction to interfere with a perceived spell as it is cast; the result determines bounded suppression or interruption progress.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.effect: End an eligible curse or release its hold under explicit scope restrictions; it does not destroy every cursed object.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.effect: Make progress toward ending an accessible ongoing spell instead of introducing a second casting-roll subsystem.

spells.name: Cancel Essence
spells.effect: Maintain a defense against a specified family of elemental or material magic, remapped from Rolemaster's Essence realm.

spells.name: Cancel Mentalism
spells.effect: Maintain a defense against specified mental magic without granting immunity to ordinary persuasion.

spells.name: Cancel Channeling
spells.effect: Maintain a defense against specified invoked or spiritual magic, remapped from Rolemaster's Channeling realm.

spells.name: Dispel True
spells.effect: Extend unravelling across the learned magical families in a bounded area, affecting allied workings too.

advanced.name: Antimagic Field
advanced.effect: Maintain a powerful area that suppresses eligible magic, including your own, with explicit exceptions and boundaries.

advanced.name: Cancel True
advanced.effect: Maintain an exceptional personal defense against the three authored magical families without universal permanent immunity.

advanced.name: Unessence
advanced.effect: Temporarily suppress one target's eligible magical channel after overcoming its resistance; HOL sets a bounded duration and recovery procedure.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Dispelling Ways (p. 80); HARP: Counterspell / Dispel Magic (p. 119).

lists.name: Sanctuary
lists.theme: Protect places and establish safe boundaries.

spells.name: Resistance
spells.effect: Give one willing creature a small, short-lived defense against a specified imminent danger. Repeated uses do not stack.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.effect: Protect a nonaggressive subject by interfering with direct hostile targeting; harmful actions end the shelter.

spells.name: Quiet Ways
spells.effect: Create a small zone through which sound does not pass, including the sounds allies may want to make.

spells.name: Tiny Hut
spells.effect: Create a temporary enclosed refuge for a bounded resting group, with explicit entry and environmental limits.

spells.name: Private Sanctum
spells.effect: Protect a prepared place against specified observation and intrusion methods.

spells.name: Hallow
spells.effect: Consecrate a place against specified supernatural threats through a substantial prepared working.

spells.name: Guards and Wards
spells.effect: Prepare layered obstacles and protective effects throughout a bounded structure using a fixed authored configuration.

spells.name: Antilife Shell
spells.effect: Maintain a barrier against eligible living creatures while leaving clear exceptions for other threats.

advanced.name: Forbiddance
advanced.effect: Protect a prepared site against specified planar travel and supernatural intruders through a major working.

advanced.name: Magnificent Mansion
advanced.effect: Create a temporary extradimensional refuge with a defined entrance, occupancy and expiry procedure.

advanced.name: Prismatic Wall — Sanctum
advanced.effect: Establish a prepared layered barrier as part of a refuge, with the same explicit breach methods as the source-inspired working.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Barrier Law and Protections; HARP: Quiet Ways (p. 136).

lists.name: Seals
lists.theme: Secure doors, containers and magical workings.

spells.name: Mage Seal
spells.effect: Magically hold one mundane closure shut. The free minor form is weak, nonstacking and ends when a new minor seal is made.

spells.name: Alarm
spells.effect: Set a clear warning when an eligible boundary or opening is crossed under the chosen trigger conditions.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.effect: Strengthen an existing closure and give specified creatures or a password access.

spells.name: Knock
spells.effect: Release an eligible lock or fastening with a conspicuous magical report; it does not conceal the intrusion.

spells.name: Magic Mouth — Warning
spells.effect: Place a fixed audible warning on a closure, triggered by specified observable events.

spells.name: Glyph of Warding
spells.effect: Prepare a stationary magical trap with an explicit trigger, stored cost and detection or removal procedure.

spells.name: Rune Mastery — Seal
spells.effect: Store one eligible known spell in a prepared seal for later release, paying both inscription and stored-spell costs.

spells.name: Secret Chest
spells.effect: Hide a prepared container beyond ordinary access through a maintained magical connection and substantial material requirements.

advanced.name: Symbol
advanced.effect: Prepare a powerful fixed magical inscription with one authored effect, trigger and removal procedure.

advanced.name: Sequester
advanced.effect: Conceal and suspend an eligible willing creature or object under specified release conditions.

advanced.name: Imprisonment — Seal
advanced.effect: Create a major prepared confinement with substantial requirements and an explicit way to release its subject.

lists.inspiration: Spell Law: Unbarring Ways and Rune Mastery; HARP: Mage Seal (p. 121).

lists.name: Channeling
lists.theme: Draw, give and redirect magical power. Transfer only existing SP; casting costs are additional. Never exceed the donor’s available SP or the recipient’s maximum. Unwilling interactions use the player-facing HOL roll; an NPC never rolls resistance. Final amounts and action profiles remain draft.

spells.name: Power Shock
spells.effect: Attack cantrip: strike one creature with a pulse of raw power. Use the normal HOL attack result for damage; final damage and condition profile TBD. This is the reliable attack page, not a free source of SP.

spells.name: Give Power
spells.effect: Send some of your existing SP to a touched willing creature, paying the casting cost separately. Rolemaster’s Channeling skill transfers power points with efficiency losses; HOL will use a bounded transfer profile instead of two percentage calculations.

spells.name: Draw Power
spells.effect: Receive existing SP from a touched willing donor. Rolemaster supports willing power-point transmission; HOL makes receiving a learned spell page without requiring a second skill roll. A donor cannot give what they do not have.

spells.name: Siphon Power
spells.effect: Drain existing SP from an unwilling creature into your reserve. Use HOL’s player-facing result to determine transfer or progress against resistance. No SP from an empty target; no HP damage is implied. This is a deliberate mana variant of life drain.

spells.name: Distant Channel
spells.effect: Give or receive SP through a visible willing partner at range. Source Channels III extends the spell levels transmitted; HOL instead extends the transfer’s reach.

spells.name: Channel Spell
spells.effect: Transmit one eligible known spell to a prepared willing ally for immediate release. Pay its normal SP and this channel’s cost. The ally neither learns nor stores the spell. Exact eligible scope remains draft.

spells.name: Directed Siphon
spells.effect: Draw SP from an unwilling target and send the recovered amount directly to a chosen recipient, willing or unwilling. Resistance affects progress; transfer cannot overfill a reserve or cause overflow damage.

spells.name: Greater Channel
spells.effect: Move a larger bounded amount of existing SP in one casting, giving or drawing between creatures. Unwilling donors and recipients require HOL resolution; an empty donor provides nothing.

advanced.name: Lord Channels
advanced.effect: Immediately learned advanced spell: coordinate several willing donors to fund one known spell. Contributions and casting overhead are paid once from existing reserves; participants do not gain spell knowledge.

advanced.name: Rechanneling
advanced.effect: Immediately learned advanced spell: intercept an active magical transfer and redirect its spell or SP to a valid recipient. Apply HOL progress against its controller; never duplicate the intercepted resource.

advanced.name: Power Bridge
advanced.effect: Immediately learned advanced spell: establish a sustained conduit between two creatures, willing or unwilling. Define resistance, throughput and maintenance in the final profile; every point received must leave the source. The source spell contacts a deity; this is a narrower HOL adaptation.

lists.inspiration: Rolemaster Companion VI: Channeling skill (p. 90), willing PP transfer and spell relay. Spell Law: Channels (p. 49), Dark Channels (p. 62), Repulsions / Rechanneling (p. 48); HARP Core: Drain Life (p. 124). SP-transfer variants are explicitly HOL adaptations. HARP College of Magics: Channel Mana (p. 103) recharges objects from ley energy, rather than transferring power between creatures.

nodes.name: Meteor Swarm
nodes.effect: Combine flame and directed force to strike several battlefield areas with burning impacts. It is a major attack with a finite shared damage budget and explicit collateral danger.

nodes.name: Wall of Thorns — Living Fortress
nodes.effect: Raise a large, shaped living fortification with passages for designated allies and dangerous thorn approaches. This is a major battlefield working, not a small crafting bonus.

nodes.name: True Resurrection
nodes.effect: Restore a willing departed person through a major prepared working informed by their history and spirit. Exceptional materials, a defined time window and no duplicate body are required.

nodes.name: Simulacrum
nodes.effect: Create one costly, capable duplicate whose borrowed appearance and animation share a strict resource and action economy. It cannot reproduce itself or refill resources freely.

nodes.name: Demiplane
nodes.effect: Create a persistent private refuge reached through a keyed doorway. Its entrance, capacity and vulnerabilities are explicit; it is not an unrestricted portal to anywhere.

nodes.name: Foresight — Shared Vigil
nodes.effect: Join distant perception to a willing mental link and grant a small group sustained warning against danger. Protection and action benefits have a shared cap.

nodes.name: Storm of Vengeance
nodes.effect: Call a major, sustained storm over a bounded battlefield. Its escalating threats follow an authored sequence, while a protected living refuge shelters designated allies.

nodes.name: Mass Lifegiving
nodes.effect: Restore a small group of recently fallen willing allies inside a prepared sanctuary, provided their fatal injuries are repaired. The shared time and material budget prevents routine mass resurrection.

nodes.name: Foresight — Oracle’s Dream
nodes.effect: A willing spirit shares a prophetic dream that grants a group a powerful, bounded foresight benefit for one declared undertaking. It reveals useful warnings, not every future event.

nodes.name: Gate — World Anchor
nodes.effect: Establish a lasting, keyed planar gateway anchored in a prepared enchanted structure. This major working requires exceptional resources, a known destination and explicit ways to close or breach it.

nodes.name: Guards and Wards — Living Citadel
nodes.effect: Create a major living stronghold with shaped stone, growing defenses and a fixed network of protective workings. Its territory, upkeep and breach conditions are bounded.
